{{Quote|A pity, though, to have to damage any of these reefs. They're genuine works of art. Unique, perhaps, in that they were created by living yet nonsentient beings. I should have liked to have studied them more closely.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
'''Pantolomin''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Panto system]], in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was an aquatic world known as one of the greatest tourist places of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==Description==
[[File:Pantolomin_Spaceport.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Pantolomin Spaceport.]]

Pantolomin was located in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] between [[Twith]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Ord Mirit]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was an [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] planet, famous for the intricate [[Coral/Legends|coral]] reefs found in the waters of its northern continent. The entire [[Star system/Legends|system]], including Pantolomin specifically, operated as a resort world for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] travelers. It offered visitors casino submarines, such as the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'', a submersible cruiser that operated in the famous oceans of Pantolomin.

Other amusements included the [[Towers of Pantolomin]], owned by a subsidiary of [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]], or [[Jervo's World]], a large network of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]-dueling arenas.

==History==
[[Garik Loran]], famed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] boy actor and later [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], was from Pantolomin.

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Pantolomin was [[Raid on Pantolomin|attacked]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] who was looking for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoffner]] and the location of the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]]. The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] bombarded the ocean in order to force the ''Coral Vanda'' to surface and surrender. Unique coral reefs were destroyed during this operation.<ref name="DFR" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attacked and conquered the planet as they invaded the systems of the Core.<ref name="TEA" />
